title: Harry Potter: Hogwarts Battle
subtitle: The Cooperative 7-Year Deck-Building Campaign
tagline: Master powerful spells, recruit loyal allies, and defend Hogwarts across seven progressive school years.
loreSummary: You are Harry, Ron, Hermione, or Neville standing between the venerable School of Witchcraft and Wizardry and the forces of darkness. Across 7 sequentially unlocked game boxes, you will acquire iconic spells, recruit allies, master house proficiencies, and collaborate to vanquish Voldemort and his Death Eaters.
keyFeatures: Cooperative 7-game campaign matching the seven school years of the saga
Progressive tuckboxes unlocking new spells, dark arts events, dice, and characters
Hero deck-building with character-specific starting equipment and growing magical arsenals
Climactic Year 7 showdown uniting all unlocked cards against the full Death Eater cabal

hp_hogwarts_seven_years.name: Full 7-Year Campaign
hp_hogwarts_seven_years.description: The complete 7-game narrative campaign from Year 1 introductory challenges to the climactic Battle of Hogwarts in Year 7.

hp_hogwarts_early_years.name: Underclassmen Years (Years 1–4)
hp_hogwarts_early_years.description: Experience the first 4 school years introducing core deck-building mechanics, house dice, and early villains.

hp_hogwarts_master_wizards.name: Master Wizard Campaign (10 Games)
hp_hogwarts_master_wizards.description: The full 7-year campaign plus 3 replayable endgame challenge sessions facing randomized high-difficulty villain rosters.

milestones.title: Chamber of Horrors
milestones.description: Unlock advanced spells, defeat initial Dark Arts events, and fend off early Hogwarts invaders.

milestones.title: The Triwizard Return
milestones.description: Incorporate house dice, survive the Triwizard trials, and face the ominous return of the Dark Lord's servants.

milestones.title: Secrets of the Half-Blood
milestones.description: Master advanced character proficiencies, combat elite Death Eaters, and uncover ancient Horcrux protections.

milestones.title: The Battle for Hogwarts
milestones.phase: Grand Climax - The Dark Lord's Defeat
milestones.description: Stand united against Lord Voldemort and the complete armada of villains to defend the castle and secure peace.
